title: Global blocking
intro: IP block lists: addresses and prefixes the box drops on the interfaces you choose, before any access list. A list comes from a file you upload or a server URL the box downloads (on a schedule if you set a refresh interval). Every import is previewed first; staged entries are applied by the normal commit.
readonly: Your role cannot change the configuration
total: {{total}} of {{max}} entries used over all lists

edit.title: Block list {{name}}
edit.name: Name
edit.nameHelp: letters, digits, . _ - (the entries are imported after saving)
edit.badName: letters, digits, . _ - only; up to 63 characters
edit.taken: a list with this name exists

import.title: Import a file into {{name}}
import.help: Plain text, one IPv4/IPv6 address or prefix per line; # starts a comment. Check shows what changes; Stage writes the entries into the candidate (the file replaces the list) and a commit applies them. Invalid lines are skipped.

fetch.title: Fetch {{name}} from its server
fetch.help: Downloads the list from its server URL now. Check shows what changes; Stage writes the entries into the candidate and a commit applies them.

preview.label: Preview
preview.summary: {{lines}} lines → {{entries}} entries: {{added}} added, {{removed}} removed, {{invalid}} invalid lines.
preview.normalised: {{normalised}} normalised (host bits masked), {{collapsed}} duplicates or covered by a wider prefix.
preview.staged: {{entries}} entries staged in the candidate; commit to apply them.

allInterfaces.title: All interfaces
allInterfaces.help: every interface, including interfaces added later

interfaces.title: Interfaces
interfaces.help: where the list is enforced (at least one unless All interfaces)

direction.title: Direction
direction.help: inbound = traffic arriving from a listed address; outbound = leaving to one

protectHost.title: Protect the box
protectHost.help: also drop traffic from listed addresses to the box itself

log.title: Log
log.help: drops to the box are logged; data-plane drops are counted
